scenarios.name: Inspect assembly opening modes and cancels

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
a recent assembly is displayed in List View
the user opens the assembly row's actions menu
the user chooses Open with options
File Open Options shows Full as the opening mode
the dialog shows Model State, Design View and Position View fields
Skip all unresolved files is unchecked
the user changes the opening mode to Express
the Design View and Position View fields are disabled
the dialog closes and the Recent list is visible
